cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll open elsewhere. Our bookshop failed here because we're meant to find different readers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we're meant to start with one shelf. You choose; I'll carry the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could get us a market stall beside the bus stop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: People waiting with nothing to read. Book it; I'll pack the short stories.

reason: Keep B solution as the next hopeful meaning; A adjusts scale and divides booking/packing labor instead of announcing that an adjustment exists.
